notes.title: Meridian: Squad 22 major updates as patch 0.96 hits!
notes.content:
Fans of Meridian: Squad 22 will be delighted to hear that the game is moving ever closer to its full release and the the game's third major update is out now. Patch 0.96 brings with it extra missions, additional achievements and a whole host of updates and fixes. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5fl9Iz6.png[/img]

- Included Mission 7: Diversion in the campaign
- Included Mission 8: The Chase in the campaign
- Added 8 new achievements
- Fixed flickering textures on top of the walls in the 'Drone' squad mission
- Fixed white flashes before all cut-scene videos
- Fixed a bug where the "attack" voice response of a unit was actually placed in 3D as if the target said it
- Fixed all texture glitches in the 'Steal Data' squad mission
- Removed unused objects from the 'Drone' squad mission, resulting in smoother performance on that map

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qxlZrdd.png[/img]

notes.title: Huge Update - Squad Missions added with massive new content and diffulty modes included
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Thanks again for all of the great feedback on the Community Hub. We have another update for you!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/XuzePxj.jpg[/img]

Changelog:
[list][*]Included 'Squad Missions' game mode with four missions and three difficulty levels
[*]Heroes no longer need to be kept alive in missions with base building, they'll just respawn
[*]Included 12 new achievements
[*]Reduced bloom threshold in desert maps in conquest mode to make them less blinding
[*]Moved console read buttons in Mission 6: Donovan's Lab to be visible from the default camera angle and easier to spot
[*]Removed some unused objects from Mission 5, resulting in a smaller memory footprint for that mission
[*]Improved several unit icons
[*]Fixed conversation timings in the intro mission so there are no awkward pauses between lines
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/gCegJ9Q.jpg[/img]

[*]Included 12 new achievements

notes.title: Meridian: Squad 22 – Second Content Update
notes.content:
The second content update for Meridian: Squad 22 will be released next week, which includes the Squad Missions game mode and four missions, each with three versions (a normal, hard and insanely difficult one)!

Squad Missions are special assignments that take place on Earth. As Council Spec Ops, your job is to carry out assassinations, retrieve stolen Council property or sabotage missions planned by the rebels. Typically, in these missions, you have a handful of specialists at your disposal and limited access to your commander abilities. Your task is to figure out how to get in and get the job done. If your plan is flawed, the alarms will go off and it's over!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/lXvtphi.jpg[/img]

Another all-important update based on community feedback is that in campaign missions with base building, you'll no longer need to keep your hero characters alive. You can safely include them in your army, if they die, they'll just respawn in the center of your base.

[b]The update also includes other fixes based on community suggestions, such as reduced brightness in conquest desert levels, UI improvements and various fixes for campaign missions.[/b]

Be sure to check back soon as the second major update for Meridian: Squad 22 goes live next week!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/o5rrBuk.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update - Missions, Achievements, Game Modes and More!
notes.content:
Hi,

Thanks for all the suggestions and comments on the Community Hub. It's really helping refine the game and we hope that with these updates you will enjoy it even more! So without further ado, here's the changelog:

[b]Version 0.88[/b]
[list]
[*]Included Mission 5: Incursion in the campaign
[*]Included Mission 6: Donovan's Lab in the campaign
[*]Included Insane missions in Conquest mode
[*]Added 10 new achievements
[*]Improved cursor visibility of the standard, active and selection cursors
[*]Fixed a bug in the Conquest random generator that sometimes placed a mountain hovering over water in a winter map
[*]Fixed a bug where the "production queue is full" message was displayed even though this was not the case
[*]Fixed a bug where Hard and Very Hard maps with water rarely had expansion points -- from now on, there's always one
[*]Fixed a bug where Gatling Turrets coldn't hit certain targets
[*]Fixed a graphics bug where Phoenixes had gaps in their shadows
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/bgn0e4Y.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Meridian: Squad 22 – First Content Update
notes.content:
The first content update for Meridian: Squad 22 will be released next week, that'll include two new campaign missions, all-new Conquest territories, as well as lots of fixes for issues posted by the community!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jvvZCvw.jpg[/img]

Conquest mode receives further balancing, more territories you can auto-conquer so the experience feels far less like a grind, and it will now include all Insane difficulty territories as well!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/nSFlHPJ.jpg[/img]

Campaign missions 5 and 6 reveal a whole lot more of Meridian: Squad 22's story, you get to make more tough decisions regarding the technology you research, and the crew finally learns the true purpose of their mission.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/n5Svfxf.jpg[/img]

Be sure to check back soon as the first major update for Meridian: Squad 22 goes live early next week!

notes.title: Traces of Squad 22
notes.content:
To celebrate the upcoming release of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/451400/]Meridian: Squad 22[/url], owners of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/265120/]Meridian: New World[/url] will get an incredible content update next week!

[h1]What this update brings to Meridian: New World[/h1]
[list][*]A new unit: a heavy tank called the Manticore
[*]A new campaign mission linking the story of New World and Squad 22
[*]Rebalanced AI with an easier „Easy” difficulty and a bit tougher „Hard” difficulty
[*]Trading Cards
[*]New achievements
[*]Additional language packs
[/list]

[h1]A new unit: the Manticore[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Qcj45Pl.jpg[/img]
The Manticore is a heavy tank developed from Scouts. It is a powerful weapon that was used by Squad 22 throughout their mission. The schematics they've left behind allows you to use this unit from Meridian: Squad 22 in skirmish battles, but be careful – the enemy will use it as well!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/zMqC0UD.jpg[/img]

[h1]A new campaign mission: Traces of Squad 22[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Ry6mdXN.jpg[/img]
After the events of Meridian: New World, Daniel Hanson and his squad are scouting the surface of Meridian to salvage as much of the abandoned outposts as possible. During their search, they encounter an outpost which used to belong to Squad 22.
The events of Meridian: Squad 22 happened after the colonists were sent to Meridian but before the central events of Meridian: New World took place. Information about Squad 22 was already found during the campaign of Meridian: New World, but you can uncover more in this brand new campaign mission!

notes.title: Meridian: Squad 22 is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Welcome to Meridian: Squad 22, the sequel to Meridian: New World!
There's a lot to discuss about the game, we'll jump right in with graphics and AI!

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
All of Meridian: Squad 22's units have much greater detail than in the prequel, Meridian: New World. Though Meridian: Squad 22 features a few units from the first game, these have been completely re-modelled and re-textured with great attention to detail.
The water effect was also re-designed for improved realism. This is especially important because Squad 22 features naval units, so the active gameplay will often be focused on the water surface.
And of course, unlike its predecessor, Squad 22 also features zooming and rotation! :)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/gEu9xq4.jpg[/img]
Above: Meridian: New World

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vRfyycV.jpg[/img]
Above: Meridian: Squad 22

[h1]Pathfinding[/h1]
In Meridian: New World, the pathfinding was sub-par because units were unaware of each other entirely. This is very clear when you take a look at how individual units attempted to find a path, they bumped into each other and immediately searched for a new path, delaying general movement. In Meridian: Squad 22 however, units accelerate and decelerate based on the surrounding units and adjust their path by predicting where nearby units will end up. This results in much smoother movement and better controls.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/7zfx27V.gif[/img]
Above: Meridian: New World AI

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Z5SiciR.gif[/img]
Above: Meridian: Squad 22 AI
